[[Taskmaster Suli]] is a [[Kournan military]] [[boss]] found in the [[Kodonur Crossroads]] [[mission]]. Killing her, along with [[Taskmaster Vanahk]] and [[Taskmaster Sadi-Belai]], is the [[bonus]] objective of the mission.

*{{skill icon|Veil of Thorns}}

==Notes==
* Regardless of whether or not she is killed during the mission, she will appear later in Vabbi as [[Corporal Suli]] with the same appearance and skills.
